purpose: State-norm + dt trajectory measurement at long context on Mamba-2.8B-hf, to localise the FP16 numerical-failure mode discussed in Section 8.2 of the paper. Three conditions x three context lengths.
label: Mamba-2.8B-hf
notes: FP16_orig uses the unpatched slow_forward and so has no trajectory record (the patched recording hook only fires when the patched function is active). For mechanistic comparison, the FP16_clip_only trajectory is the closest reference: it uses the same patched function but does not quantise, so any divergence between FP16_orig PPL and FP16_clip_only h_abs trajectory is attributable to the calibrated clipping. To measure FP16_orig state-magnitude trajectory directly, a second pass with mode='off' (patched function, no clipping, no quantisation) would be needed.
